answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a public bond ledger before it can trade. Reputation then accrues slowly to that one bonded identity, like sand building a dune grain by grain, so a fresh copy starts with nothing. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must post a thousand bonds, and each gale of slashing penalties strips the stake of any identity caught cheating, while honest agents keep their bond and climb the knoll of trust. Forging identities stops being free and starts costing real capital per copy.
